props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-523923ea e-con-full firsthealt-sec e-flex e-con e-child

children: How long does fintech app development take?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-511aae3 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: A basic fintech application takes 3 to 6 months. Complex platforms with advanced AI, blockchain integration, and multi-bank connectivity take 9 months or more. The timeline is defined precisely in the Discovery Sprint based on scope, compliance requirements, and integration complexity.
How do you handle financial data security?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-5efb6021 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: End-to-end encryption, secure APIs, biometric authentication, and strict access controls are applied across every fintech application. PCI DSS, GDPR, and KYC/AML compliance are built into the architecture from day one. Not added before delivery.

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-5e5ed9bd e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Yes. Regular updates, feature enhancements, security patches, and performance monitoring are provided continuously after deployment. Financial applications require ongoing compliance alignment as regulations evolve — that is part of the post-launch engagement.
Can you integrate with banks and payment systems?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-1428ccf0 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Yes. Financial APIs, payment gateways, and banking networks are integrated securely into every fintech application. Plaid, Stripe, PayPal, and major banking network connectivity are built for reliable, real-time transactions.
